chunks: Our Lord, bring us out of it. If we were to return [to sin], we would surely be wrongdoers.
ai.seo_question: What do the believers in Hell say about returning to the world if they were to go back?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the self-awareness of the damned who recognize that their continued punishment is a direct consequence of their own free choices rather than divine injustice. It serves as a profound lesson on accountability, illustrating that the 'wrongdoers' are those who knowingly persist in their transgressions despite having the opportunity to repent. This acknowledgment underscores the principle of 'Adl' (Divine Justice), where the punishment fits the deliberate nature of the sin.
